'''Tala''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who worked with the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Gus (Drall)|Gus]] and [[Conevor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the war, Conevor bet his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that Tala could win any race. [[Jostero]], the leader of the [[Silestro Privateers]], challenged her to a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race. Shortly before the race finished, Gus informed Conevor that no matter the outcome of the race the privateers planned on [[Death/Legends|killing]] the trio and taking their belongings. Tala won the race, but before the [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] could attack the three comrades, a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] belonging to the [[Corellian Security Force]] arrived and both parties involved in the race fled.
